_about: PlayStation light-gun games for acvr-ps1. Keys are catalog ids. gun: the device the game reads; port: the controller port it is plugged into; view: theatre now, true3d planned for polygon games. No locations here: each player's own launcher maps a key to their own disc.

ps1-point-blank.notes: GunCon A or B skips the intro and passes calibration; shoot menu items.

ps1-mighty-hits-special.notes: European release; asks for a language first.

ps1-ghoul-panic.notes: Both releases (Japanese: Oh! Bakyuuun) read the GunCon through the light-pen interrupt, which the stereo core does not emulate, so they play on the theatre core.

ps1-time-crisis.notes: Hold GunCon A or B (the right grip) to step out and shoot; let go to take cover and reload.

ps1-time-crisis-project-titan.notes: Hold GunCon A or B (the right grip) to step out and shoot; let go to take cover and reload.

ps1-die-hard-trilogy.notes: Only Die Hard 2 (the gun game) uses the gun; the other two need a gamepad.

ps1-die-hard-trilogy-2-viva-las-vegas.notes: GunCon in port 2: the game wants a pad in port 1 (the left controller).

ps1-extreme-ghostbusters.notes: European release: kept on the theatre core, whose GunCon works with PAL discs.

ps1-gunfighter-the-legend-of-jesse-james.notes: Has its own light-gun calibration screen.

ps1-maximum-force.notes: Digitised actors over pre-rendered scenes: no PGXP depth, so theatre, with a diorama prototype.

ps1-resident-evil-survivor.notes: The North American release (SLUS-01087) has no light-gun support; the Japanese and European releases do.

ps1-elemental-gearbolt.notes: Real 3D through the SwanStation stereo patch.

ps1-rescue-shot.notes: Real 3D on the Japanese release (Rescue Shot Bubibo); the European release stays on the theatre core because the stereo core's GunCon calibration stalls on PAL discs.

ps1-project-horned-owl.notes: Justifier in port 1; its Start button (right A) works the menus. The GunCon is not read. The Japanese release is Horned Owl.
